
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="id">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#080808">
<meta name="description" content="VENN STORE - Rokok, parfum, pomade, dan layanan tukar LKR ke IDR.">
<title>VENN STORE | Original Products & Currency Exchange</title>
<style>
:root{--gold:#d7a63b;--gold2:#ffe08a;--bg:#070707;--card:#111;--muted:#aaa;--line:rgba(215,166,59,.25);--white:#f5f5f5}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}html{scroll-behavior:smooth}body{font-family:Inter,Arial,sans-serif;background:radial-gradient(circle at top,#1a150b 0,#070707 38%,#030303 100%);color:var(--white);line-height:1.6}.wrap{max-width:1180px;margin:auto;padding:0 20px}
header{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:50;background:rgba(5,5,5,.88);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}.nav{height:70px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between}.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:2px}.brand img{width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;border:1px solid var(--gold)}.brand span{color:var(--gold2)}nav{display:flex;gap:22px}nav a{color:#ddd;text-decoration:none;font-size:14px}nav a:hover{color:var(--gold2)}.menu{display:none;background:none;border:1px solid var(--line);color:white;padding:8px 10px;border-radius:8px}
.hero{padding:65px 0 45px}.hero-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr .9fr;gap:45px;align-items:center}.eyebrow{color:var(--gold2);letter-spacing:3px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:12px}.hero h1{font-size:clamp(42px,7vw,78px);line-height:.98;margin-bottom:20px}.hero h1 span{color:var(--gold)}.hero p{color:#c5c5c5;max-width:620px;margin-bottom:25px}.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:13px 20px;border-radius:10px;text-decoration:none;font-weight:800;border:1px solid var(--gold);cursor:pointer}.btn-gold{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#b47b18,#ffe08a,#b47b18);color:#111}.btn-dark{color:white;background:#101010;margin-left:8px}.hero-logo{display:flex;justify-content:center}.hero-logo img{width:min(440px,90vw);aspect-ratio:1;object-fit:cover;border-radius:50%;filter:drop-shadow(0 15px 35px rgba(215,166,59,.22));border:1px solid var(--gold)}
.section{padding:60px 0}.section-title{text-align:center;margin-bottom:30px}.section-title small{color:var(--gold2);letter-spacing:3px}.section-title h2{font-size:34px;margin-top:5px}.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:18px}.card{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#141414,#0a0a0a);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:22px;transition:.25s}.card:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);border-color:rgba(255,224,138,.65)}.icon{font-size:30px;margin-bottom:12px}.card h3{margin-bottom:7px}.card p{font-size:14px;color:var(--muted)}
.exchange{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:25px}.panel{background:#0e0e0e;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;padding:26px}.rate{font-size:13px;color:#bbb;margin:8px 0 20px}.field{margin:12px 0}.field label{display:block;font-size:12px;color:#aaa;margin-bottom:6px}.field input,.field select{width:100%;padding:13px;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid #333;background:#080808;color:white;outline:none}.field input:focus{border-color:var(--gold)}.result{font-size:28px;font-weight:900;color:var(--gold2);margin-top:18px}.note{font-size:12px;color:#888;margin-top:12px}
.products{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:18px}.product{overflow:hidden;padding:0}.product .pic{height:190px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#1c160b,#090909);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:55px}.product-body{padding:20px}.tag{display:inline-block;color:#111;background:var(--gold2);padding:3px 8px;border-radius:99px;font-size:10px;font-weight:900;margin-bottom:9px}.price{color:var(--gold2);font-weight:900;font-size:20px;margin:10px 0}.product button{width:100%;border:1px solid var(--gold);background:#15110a;color:var(--gold2);padding:11px;border-radius:9px;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer}.product button:hover{background:#241b0b}
.age{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.86);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;z-index:100;padding:20px}.age-box{max-width:480px;background:#111;border:1px solid var(--gold);border-radius:18px;padding:30px;text-align:center;box-shadow:0 20px 70px #000}.age-box h2{color:var(--gold2);margin-bottom:10px}.age-box p{color:#bbb;font-size:14px}.age-actions{display:flex;gap:10px;margin-top:20px}.age-actions button{flex:1;padding:12px;border-radius:9px;border:1px solid var(--gold);font-weight:800;cursor:pointer}.yes{background:var(--gold);color:#111}.no{background:#111;color:white}
footer{border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding:35px 0;color:#888;text-align:center;font-size:13px}.footer-brand{color:var(--gold2);font-weight:900;letter-spacing:2px;margin-bottom:7px}.wa{position:fixed;right:20px;bottom:20px;z-index:60;background:#25d366;color:#06150a;border-radius:50px;padding:13px 17px;text-decoration:none;font-weight:900;box-shadow:0 10px 30px #000}
@media(max-width:850px){nav{display:none}.menu{display:block}.hero-grid,.exchange{grid-template-columns:1fr}.grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.products{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.hero{text-align:center}.hero p{margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto}.btn{margin:4px}.hero-logo{order:-1}}
@media(max-width:560px){.wrap{padding:0 14px}.grid,.products{grid-template-columns:1fr}.section{padding:45px 0}.hero{padding-top:35px}.hero h1{font-size:48px}.age-box{padding:23px}}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<header><div class="wrap nav"><a class="brand" href="#home"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="VENN STORE"><span>VENN STORE</span></a><nav><a href="#home">Home</a><a href="#exchange">LKR ⇄ IDR</a><a href="#products">Produk</a><a href="#contact">Kontak</a></nav><button class="menu" onclick="alert('Gunakan menu di bawah: Home, LKR ⇄ IDR, Produk, Kontak')">☰</button></div></header>
<main id="home">
<section class="hero"><div class="wrap hero-grid"><div><div class="eyebrow">ORIGINAL PRODUCTS • TRUSTED STORE</div><h1>WELCOME TO<br><span>VENN STORE</span></h1><p>Temukan pilihan rokok, parfum, pomade, serta layanan tukar mata uang LKR dan IDR dalam satu tempat.</p><a href="#products" class="btn btn-gold">LIHAT PRODUK</a><a href="#exchange" class="btn btn-dark">TUKAR LKR ⇄ IDR</a></div><div class="hero-logo"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="VENN STORE Logo"></div></div></section>
<section class="section"><div class="wrap"><div class="section-title"><small>OUR SERVICES</small><h2>Semua Lebih Praktis</h2></div><div class="grid"><div class="card"><div class="icon">🚬</div><h3>Rokok</h3><p>Katalog produk tembakau untuk pelanggan yang memenuhi batas usia yang berlaku.</p></div><div class="card"><div class="icon">💱</div><h3>LKR ⇄ IDR</h3><p>Hitung perkiraan nilai tukar LKR ke Rupiah secara cepat.</p></div><div class="card"><div class="icon">🌸</div><h3>Parfum</h3><p>Pilihan aroma untuk penggunaan sehari-hari dan berbagai kesempatan.</p></div><div class="card"><div class="icon">💈</div><h3>Pomade</h3><p>Produk styling rambut dengan pilihan tingkat hold dan shine.</p></div></div></div></section>
<section id="exchange" class="section"><div class="wrap"><div class="section-title"><small>CURRENCY EXCHANGE</small><h2>Kalkulator LKR ⇄ IDR</h2></div><div class="exchange"><div class="panel"><h3>Konversi LKR ke IDR</h3><div class="rate">Rate contoh: <strong id="rateText">1 LKR = 300 IDR</strong>. Ubah rate sesuai kurs toko.</div><div class="field"><label>Jumlah LKR</label><input id="lkr" type="number" min="0" value="1000" oninput="convert()"></div><div class="result" id="idrResult">Rp 300.000</div><div class="note">Hasil hanya estimasi. Rate aktual dapat berbeda dari kurs pasar atau rate transaksi.</div></div><div class="panel"><h3>Konversi IDR ke LKR</h3><div class="field"><label>Jumlah IDR</label><input id="idr" type="number" min="0" value="300000" oninput="convertBack()"></div><div class="result" id="lkrResult">LKR 1,000</div><div class="note">Untuk transaksi aktual, konfirmasi rate dan biaya layanan kepada VENN STORE.</div></div></div></div></section>
<section id="products" class="section"><div class="wrap"><div class="section-title"><small>PRODUCT COLLECTION</small><h2>Produk VENN STORE</h2></div><div class="products"><article class="card product"><div class="pic">🚬</div><div class="product-body"><span class="tag">18+ / SESUAI ATURAN</span><h3>Rokok</h3><p>Informasi dan ketersediaan produk dapat dikonfirmasi langsung.</p><div class="price">Hubungi toko</div><button onclick="contact('Rokok')">Tanya Ketersediaan</button></div></article><article class="card product"><div class="pic">🌹</div><div class="product-body"><span class="tag">PARFUME</span><h3>Parfum</h3><p>Pilihan parfum dengan berbagai karakter aroma.</p><div class="price">Mulai LKR 2,500</div><button onclick="contact('Parfum')">Tanya Produk</button></div></article><article class="card product"><div class="pic">💈</div><div class="product-body"><span class="tag">HAIR STYLING</span><h3>Pomade</h3><p>Pomade untuk membantu membentuk dan menata rambut.</p><div class="price">Mulai LKR 1,800</div><button onclick="contact('Pomade')">Tanya Produk</button></div></article></div></div></section>
<section id="contact" class="section"><div class="wrap"><div class="panel" style="text-align:center"><div class="eyebrow">VENN STORE</div><h2>Butuh informasi produk atau kurs?</h2><p style="color:#aaa;margin:8px 0 20px">Hubungi kami untuk mengecek ketersediaan, harga, dan rate transaksi terbaru.</p><a class="btn btn-gold" id="waMain" href="#">CHAT WHATSAPP</a></div></div></section>
</main>
<footer><div class="wrap"><div class="footer-brand">VENN STORE</div><div>Original Products • Trusted Store</div><div style="margin-top:8px">© <span id="year"></span> VENN STORE. All rights reserved.</div></div></footer>
<a class="wa" id="waFloat" href="#">WhatsApp</a>
<div class="age" id="ageModal"><div class="age-box"><h2>Verifikasi Usia</h2><p>Bagian katalog rokok pada situs ini ditujukan hanya untuk orang yang telah memenuhi batas usia legal sesuai peraturan yang berlaku di wilayah Anda.</p><div class="age-actions"><button class="yes" onclick="enterSite()">Saya memenuhi batas usia</button><button class="no" onclick="leaveSite()">Keluar</button></div></div></div>
<script>
// ===================== KONFIGURASI TOKO =====================
const CONFIG={
  whatsapp:'94700000000', // GANTI dengan nomor WhatsApp, contoh: 94771234567
  rate:300 // CONTOH: 1 LKR = 300 IDR. GANTI sesuai rate toko.
};
function rupiah(n){return new Intl.NumberFormat('id-ID',{style:'currency',currency:'IDR',maximumFractionDigits:0}).format(n)}
function convert(){const v=Number(document.getElementById('lkr').value)||0;document.getElementById('idrResult').textContent=rupiah(v*CONFIG.rate)}
function convertBack(){const v=Number(document.getElementById('idr').value)||0;document.getElementById('lkrResult').textContent='LKR '+new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US',{maximumFractionDigits:2}).format(v/CONFIG.rate)}
function contact(product){const msg=encodeURIComponent('Halo VENN STORE, saya ingin menanyakan produk: '+product);window.open('https://wa.me/'+CONFIG.whatsapp+'?text='+msg,'_blank')}
function setupWA(){const url='https://wa.me/'+CONFIG.whatsapp+'?text='+encodeURIComponent('Halo VENN STORE, saya ingin bertanya mengenai produk dan layanan.');document.getElementById('waMain').href=url;document.getElementById('waFloat').href=url;document.getElementById('rateText').textContent='1 LKR = '+CONFIG.rate.toLocaleString('id-ID')+' IDR';convert();convertBack()}
function enterSite(){localStorage.setItem('vennAgeOK','1');document.getElementById('ageModal').style.display='none'}
function leaveSite(){document.body.innerHTML='<div style="min-height:100vh;display:grid;place-items:center;background:#070707;color:#fff;font-family:Arial;text-align:center;padding:30px"><div><h2>Terima kasih.</h2><p style="color:#aaa;margin-top:8px">Anda dapat menutup halaman ini.</p></div></div>'}
document.getElementById('year').textContent=new Date().getFullYear();setupWA();if(localStorage.getItem('vennAgeOK')==='1')document.getElementById('ageModal').style.display='none';
</script>
</body>
</html>
